faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I book a flight?
faq.a1: To book a flight, use our search tool on the home page. Select your departure and arrival cities, choose your travel dates, and click 'Search Flights'. Select your preferred flight and proceed to payment.
faq.a2: You can cancel your booking up to 24 hours before departure for a full refund. Cancellations made within 24 hours of departure may be subject to cancellation fees.
faq.q3: How do I manage my booking?
faq.a3: You can manage your booking by visiting 'My Bookings' page. There you can view details, change seats, add baggage, or cancel your reservation if needed.
